question: The density of population is the crude relationship between human and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**land**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Density of population** refers to the number of people living per unit area of **land**.
 
• This metric is important for understanding how populated an area is and can influence planning and resource allocation.
 
• It is **calculated by dividing the total population by the total land area**.
 
• **Higher population density** can indicate **urbanization**, while **lower population density **may be indicative of **rural areas**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Population density is a crucial factor in **urban planning** and **development policies**.
 
• Regions with high population density may face challenges like **overcrowding, pollution, and strain on resources**.
 
• Conversely, areas with low population density might struggle with **underdevelopment and lack of services**.
 
• Understanding population density helps governments and organizations to plan for **infrastructure, healthcare, education, and other essential services**.
 
• Population density varies widely across different parts of the world and can be influenced by factors such as **geography, climate, and economic opportunities**.
